test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many folds is/are required to fold an A2 size drawing sheet (420 mm × 594 mm), according to BIS SP: 46-2003?
solution:
__**Concept:**__

According to **BIS SP: 46–2003**, drawing sheets are folded so that they fit into a standard file size (A4: 210 mm × 297 mm).

For folding rules:

 
• The sheet is folded parallel to the shorter side into panels of A4 width (210 mm).
